methodology_note: Evaluated against independent gold standard. In-sample (N=30) measures error-taxonomy rule refinement. Holdout (N=20) measures directional unseen generalization.
labeling_provenance: Independent Claude 3.5 Sonnet sub-agent extraction blind to pipeline, with 15 ambiguous edge-case cells manually spot-checked in official documentation by candidate.
evidence_verification_rate: 115 of 121 cited quotes (95.0%) verified against live pages; unverified or blocked pages routed to human review queue.

error_taxonomy.root_cause: Agent extracted legacy API key patterns from older documentation; platforms sunset keys in favor of Private App Bearer tokens and PATs.
error_taxonomy.resolution: Updated verifier prompt to search specifically for deprecation notices, sunset dates, and active token creation workflows.

error_taxonomy.root_cause: Agent saw free trial for websites and assumed API key was available on trial; Commerce Advanced plan is strictly required for API keys.
error_taxonomy.resolution: Cross-checked developer docs against plan-level feature matrices.

error_taxonomy.root_cause: Agent assumed software repositories with high popularity offered REST endpoints; they are standalone command-line tools without hosted SaaS APIs.
error_taxonomy.resolution: Added package-type heuristic: GitHub npm/pip repositories without HTTP endpoints are classified as CLI-only.

error_taxonomy.type: Consumer App vs Enterprise API Conflation
error_taxonomy.root_cause: Agent conflated Google Gemini / Vertex AI developer APIs with consumer NotebookLM, which has no standalone public REST endpoints.
error_taxonomy.resolution: Enforced strict entity disambiguation between consumer end-user products and developer API platforms.
